harnessNotes.*: This skill drives packages/leakguard. Read scripts/leakguard.root for the absolute package path; if you copied the skill folder by hand without the install command, locate packages/leakguard in the gti-skills repository and use its bin/leakguard.mjs and bin/leakguard-hook.mjs paths.
harnessNotes.cursor: The guard installs as a command hook (preToolUse) in .cursor/hooks.json or ~/.cursor/hooks.json.
harnessNotes.claude: The guard installs as a command hook (PreToolUse) in .claude/settings.json or ~/.claude/settings.json.
harnessNotes.codex: The guard installs as a command hook (PreToolUse) in .codex/hooks.json or ~/.codex/hooks.json. Hooks must be reviewed and trusted in /hooks before they run.
harnessNotes.antigravity: The guard installs as a command hook (PreToolUse) in .agents/hooks.json or ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json.
harnessNotes.copilot: The guard installs as a command hook (preToolUse) in a dedicated .github/hooks/leakguard.json or ~/.copilot/hooks/leakguard.json.
harnessNotes.kiro: The guard installs as a command hook (preToolUse) in .kiro/hooks/leakguard.json or ~/.kiro/hooks/leakguard.json.
harnessNotes.opencode: The guard installs as an in-process plugin shim in .opencode/plugins/leakguard.mjs, not as a command hook; there is no JSON on stdin.
harnessNotes.kilo: The guard installs as an in-process plugin shim in .kilo/plugin/leakguard.mjs, not as a command hook; there is no JSON on stdin.
harnessNotes.cline: No command hook is available; register plugins/cline/leakguard.mjs in the session's plugin config. Leak scanning still works.
harnessNotes.muse: Unsupported: no documented pre-tool hook exists. This skill can only scan for earlier leaks here; do not attempt to install a guard into Muse.
